title: Streamed AI assistant with route tools
prompt: Add POST /assistant with body { message } (1 to 4000 characters). It streams the "fast" AI model alias's answer to the browser as server-sent events, letting the model call the existing createNote and listNotes routes as tools while it streams, so it can create and list the signed-in user's notes. The browser should see the text, each tool call and each tool result's status, but not what the tools returned. Track AI usage for the user.
